# Site for sale

> Ervallagh is a truly unique holiday location situated between Roundstone village and the renowned white sand beaches at Gurteen and Dogs Bay. The stone built semi-ruinous property stands on a large elevated plot and fronting onto a small lake. It is less than a minutes' walk to Ervallagh beach and pier.

## Fakta
- Typ: site
- Druh nabídky: sale
- Energetická náročnost: Exempt
- Lokalita: Ervallagh, Roundstone
- Cena: 195 000 €
